identityCorrections.identity_note: Use the independent adverb/interjection entry, interpreting the terse source 'really' as the response 'really?/is that so?', not the appearance auxiliary. The source English is underspecified; do not teach this as a general-purpose intensifier meaning 'very' or 'truly'.
The demonstrative source gloss is incompatible with the interjection entry.
Thing or matter, not the homographic sentence-final particle.

Original entry 2846389 has only rare slang cop/police officer, contradicting the source gloss a glass. Corrected entry 1050390 sense 1 means glass (drinking vessel)/tumbler with unrestricted reading コップ and usual kana spelling. Drinking vessel, not the rare loanword for police officer.

2546180 has only the Izumo-dialect interjection thank you, which does not match sourceGloss gradually. 1597350 sense 1 is gradually/by degrees/little by little, usually kana, reading だんだん with no sense restriction.

1182880 refers to tree peony; its boar-meat sense is restricted to ぼたん. Neither matches sourceGloss button. 1123880 has unrestricted reading ボタン, clothing button sense 1 and push-button sense 2, both usually kana.
Demonstrative this, not the homographic calling interjection.

indexSemantics.source_id: N-level:physical CSV line number, including the header at line 1.
indexSemantics.source_kanji: Original CSV kanji field, including empty values; the original written form is this or source_reading.
indexSemantics.source_gloss: Original Waller gloss retained for identification, not endorsed verbatim as teaching guidance.
indexSemantics.article: Stable repository-relative word page covering this row's reading and intended meaning.
indexSemantics.article_level: Easiest sourced level among the source rows taught by the article; individual senses/readings can have different source levels.
indexSemantics.sense_indices: Non-exhaustive selected teaching senses, one-based within the recorded JMdict snapshot; other entry senses are not automatically article claims.
indexSemantics.additional_senses: Other explicitly distinguished homograph senses, as semicolon-separated entry:sense pairs; not extra source rows or separate level assignments.
indexSemantics.mapping_note: Documented spelling normalization, stable article reuse or unchanged source spelling.
indexSemantics.identity_note: Correction of an incorrect supplied lexical identity; source_jmdict_entry is never overwritten.
indexSemantics.source_note: Source-gloss qualification, spelling/sense distinction or an explicitly retained ambiguity; not a new membership assignment.

limits: Rows, dictionary IDs, lexical identities and articles are different counting units.
Kana surfaces may be valid even when the dictionary pair index enumerates only kanji spellings.
Sense restrictions are checked against compatible spellings and readings; the particular intended use still requires editorial adjudication.
Dictionary identity does not establish examination membership, usage frequency or sentence naturalness.
N4 study is cumulative with N5; the selected source files omit standalone entries for several fundamental particles.
Alternative distributions descended from Waller are not independent level corroboration.

For マッチ, the source English 'match' does not settle contest versus matchstick. The supplied primary identity is preserved and both are distinguished; no sense-specific official N5 assignment is claimed.
